summary: Everyone asks themselves the same thing: what’s in it for me? David Ogilvy spent his whole career answering that question.
takeaways: David Ogilvy spent his whole career answering that question.
People call him the father of advertising, and for good reason.
He wrote iconic campaigns for Rolls-Royce, Dove, and Hathaway shirts, and his book, Ogilvy on Advertising, is still in print forty years later.
